title: ManiFusion: Unlocking the High-Throughput Generation via Superposition in Manifold Space
title_zh: ManiFusion：通过流形空间中的叠加实现高通量生成

paragraphs.en: ManiFusion 是一个通过流形空间中的叠加实现高吞吐量生成的框架。 Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.
paragraphs.zh: ManiFusion 是一个通过流形空间中的叠加实现高吞吐量生成的框架。扩散模型能够实现高质量的图像生成，但由于需要在多个时间步上进行迭代去噪，其计算开销仍然很高。 现有的加速方法主要降低单样本延迟，但沿这一方向的收益正趋于饱和。 我们转而探索一个正交的、面向吞吐量的方向，即在单次去噪评估中处理多个样本。 为此，我们提出 ManiFusion，一个与骨干网络无关、通过融合空间计算实现多样本生成的框架。 ManiFusion 通过在去噪骨干网络之前融合多个样本来联合处理它们，并在之后通过解融合将它们分离。 我们从几何视角阐释了多个样本如何共享一个融合表示，同时保留引导其各自生成轨迹所需的信息。 为了使融合分配与去噪阶段更好地对齐，ManiFusion 采用轨迹融合调度（TFS），在整个采样过程中动态调整融合因子。 ManiFusion 可泛化于各类扩散模型家族，涵盖像素空间和潜在空间中的 U-Net 与 transformer 骨干网络。 我们进一步证明，ManiFusion 可与现有加速方法组合使用，以极小的质量损失达到先前方法无法企及的吞吐量水平。
